categories.main_business_segments: HanmiGlobal Co., Ltd. primarily operates in construction project management, including construction management services, architectural design and supervision, civil engineering, quality assurance, and related consulting services. The company also engages in real estate development, facility maintenance, renewable energy projects, and energy consulting. Its business model includes both service-type (consulting and management) and responsibility-type (construction management with direct construction responsibilities) project management.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced construction management methodologies such as Off-Site Construction (OSC) and Integrated Project Delivery (IPD), emphasizing early-stage project involvement to optimize cost, schedule, and quality. It employs Building Information Modeling (BIM)-based management processes and integrates digital transformation and AI technologies (e.g., HanmiGTP) to enhance project management efficiency. Research and development focus on construction productivity, cost estimation systems, and sustainable building practices.
categories.primary_customers_markets: HanmiGlobal serves a diverse customer base including public sector clients (government agencies, public institutions) and private sector clients such as large corporations (e.g., Samsung Electronics) and real estate developers. Its markets span domestic Korean construction projects and international projects in the Middle East, North America, Europe, and Central Asia, with significant activities in infrastructure, residential, commercial, and high-tech facilities.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in South Korea but has expanded globally with subsidiaries and projects in the United States (Oregon, Washington, Colorado), the United Kingdom, Kazakhstan, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Hungary, Malaysia, and Libya. It maintains multiple overseas subsidiaries and has acquired foreign firms to strengthen its presence in North America and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: HanmiGlobal operates primarily as a midstream service provider in the construction supply chain, acting as an agent and coordinator on behalf of project owners. It manages the entire construction project lifecycle from planning, design, procurement, to construction supervision and post-construction management. In responsibility-type projects, it also assumes direct construction responsibilities, bridging midstream and downstream roles.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes risk-centered management, global business expansion, and digital transformation including AI integration. Its R&D efforts focus on advancing construction management technologies, sustainable and green building solutions, and new project delivery methods like OSC and IPD. HanmiGlobal also emphasizes ESG management, safety, and social responsibility, aiming to lead innovation in construction project management and related consulting services.
categories.revenue_model: HanmiGlobal generates revenue primarily through service contracts for construction project management, including consulting, supervision, and responsibility-type construction management. Revenue streams include periodic billing based on project progress, with contracts typically settled in cash. The company also earns income from real estate development, facility leasing, and related advisory services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: HanmiGlobal is positioned as a leading construction project management firm in South Korea and is expanding its global footprint. It competes with other domestic and international construction management and engineering firms, leveraging its long-standing expertise, comprehensive service offerings, and advanced technological capabilities. Its pure-play construction management focus differentiates it from traditional supervision or construction companies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, HanmiGlobal reported consolidated revenues of approximately KRW 412.9 billion with operating income of KRW 29.6 billion and net income of KRW 16.7 billion. The company has shown a 10% revenue growth year-over-year despite challenges in profitability due to real estate market downturns. It maintains a solid asset base of nearly KRW 399 billion and a balanced capital structure with a debt ratio around 97%. The firm continues to invest in growth through acquisitions and global market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: HanmiGlobal offers comprehensive, integrated construction project management solutions that enhance project efficiency, cost control, and quality from early planning through completion. Its differentiation lies in deep technical expertise, advanced digital and AI-enabled management systems, and a strong commitment to ESG principles and safety. The company’s global network and ability to provide total solutions including engineering, construction, and development services position it as a trusted partner for complex, large-scale projects.
